v1_text:
1. Continuous Voter Registration

Eligible citizens may register to vote at any registration centre until 31 December 2026.

2. Eligibility

A person must be at least 18 years old and a citizen of Nigeria to register.
---
3. Collection of PVC

Registered voters must collect their Permanent Voter's Card within 30 days of notification.

4. Accreditation

Voters must present their PVC for accreditation before voting.

Voters may be accompanied by one companion while waiting.
v2_text:
1. Continuous Voter Registration

Eligible citizens may register to vote at any registration centre until 15 January 2027.

2. Eligibility

A person must be at least 18 years old and a citizen of Nigeria to register.
---
3. Collection of PVC

Registered voters must collect their Permanent Voter's Card within 60 days of notification.

4. Accreditation

Voters must present their PVC and a valid form of identification for accreditation before voting.

5. Transfer of registration

Voters who have moved may apply for transfer of registration during the registration window.

document_title: Polling Unit Accreditation and Voting Procedure Notice
v1_text:
1. Polling Unit Opening and Closing Hours

Accreditation and voting at all polling units shall close promptly at 2:00 PM.

2. Biometric Authentication on BVAS

Where fingerprint authentication fails on the BVAS device, the Presiding Officer shall issue an Incident Form to the voter.
---
3. Voter Registration Eligibility

To register as a voter, an applicant must be at least 18 years old and provide proof of 12 months residency in the ward.

4. Presiding Officer Logbook

The Presiding Officer shall record the serial number of the BVAS device before opening the poll.
v2_text:
1. Polling Unit Opening and Closing Hours

Accreditation and voting at all polling units shall close promptly at 2:30 PM, provided voters already in the queue at 2:30 PM shall be allowed to vote.

2. Biometric Authentication on BVAS

Where fingerprint authentication fails on the BVAS device, the Presiding Officer shall verify the voter strictly by BVAS facial authentication without issuing any Incident Form.
---
3. Voter Registration Eligibility

To register as a voter, an applicant must be at least 18 years old and a citizen of Nigeria without any minimum ward residency duration requirement.

4. Presiding Officer Logbook

The Presiding Officer shall record the serial number and battery level of the BVAS device before opening the poll.

document_title: Voter Transfer and Claims & Objections Regulations
v1_text:
1. Timeline for Transfer of Registered Voters

Applications for transfer of voter registration must be submitted not later than 30 days before election day.

2. Display of Preliminary Register for Claims and Objections

The preliminary register of voters shall be displayed at ward headquarters for 7 days for public scrutiny.
---
3. Replacement of Lost or Damaged PVC

An application for replacement of a lost Permanent Voter's Card must include a sworn court affidavit and a police extract.

4. Archiving of Objections

Revision officers shall file daily summaries of claims received at the ward centre.
v2_text:
1. Timeline for Transfer of Registered Voters

Applications for transfer of voter registration must be submitted not later than 90 days before election day.

2. Display of Preliminary Register for Claims and Objections

The preliminary register of voters shall be displayed at ward headquarters and online for 14 days for public scrutiny.
---
3. Replacement of Lost or Damaged PVC

An application for replacement of a lost Permanent Voter's Card must include a completed Form EC-9B and National Identification Number verification without requiring a police extract.

4. Archiving of Objections

Revision officers shall file daily electronic summaries of claims received at the ward centre.

document_title: Framework and Guidelines for Internally Displaced Persons (IDP) Voting
v1_text:
1. IDP Voter Revalidation Deadline

Internally displaced persons in designated camps must complete voter record revalidation by 10 October 2026.

2. Accreditation Documents at IDP Polling Centres

Displaced voters without a physical PVC may be accredited using a camp registration slip signed by the camp manager.
---
3. Scope of Elections for Out-of-State IDP Camps

Displaced voters residing in camps outside their home state are eligible to vote in Presidential and Governorship elections.

4. Security Escort for IDP Materials

Sensitive materials for IDP centres shall be accompanied by unarmed civil defence personnel.
v2_text:
1. IDP Voter Revalidation Deadline

Internally displaced persons in designated camps must complete voter record revalidation by 25 November 2026.

2. Accreditation Documents at IDP Polling Centres

Displaced voters at IDP polling centres must present a reissued Permanent Voter's Card or be verified on the BVAS camp register; camp registration slips shall not be accepted.
---
3. Scope of Elections for Out-of-State IDP Camps

Displaced voters residing in camps outside their home state are eligible to vote only in the Presidential election.

4. Security Escort for IDP Materials

Sensitive materials for IDP centres shall be accompanied by inter-agency electoral security personnel.

document_title: Guidelines on Persons with Disabilities (PWD) and Assistive Voting
v1_text:
1. Deployment of Braille Ballot Guides

Braille ballot guides shall be deployed only to urban polling units with at least 20 registered visually impaired voters.

2. Priority Queue Access

Pregnant women, nursing mothers, and persons with disabilities may join the general queue or request priority access after 11:00 AM.
---
3. Eligibility of Assisting Companions

A voter with a physical disability who requires assistance in the voting cubicle may be assisted by any person including a party agent.

4. Form EC40H Disability Recording

Presiding Officers shall record disaggregated disability participation counts on Form EC40H.
v2_text:
1. Deployment of Braille Ballot Guides

Braille ballot guides and magnifying sheets shall be deployed to all polling units nationwide with at least 1 registered visually impaired voter.

2. Priority Queue Access

Pregnant women, nursing mothers, elderly citizens, and persons with disabilities shall be granted immediate priority queue access from 8:30 AM.
---
3. Eligibility of Assisting Companions

A voter with a physical disability who requires assistance in the voting cubicle must be assisted by a trusted family member of their choice and shall not be assisted by a party agent or poll official.

4. Form EC40H Disability Recording

Presiding Officers shall record disaggregated disability participation counts on Form EC40H and transmit the summary.

document_title: Polling Unit Delimitation and Emergency Relocation Circular
v1_text:
1. Threshold for Splitting Populous Polling Units

A polling unit shall be split into sub-units only when the number of registered voters exceeds 1,000 voters.

2. Notice Period for Relocated Polling Units

Notice of any polling unit relocated from a private residence or worship centre must be published at least 7 days before the election.
---
3. Climate and Flood Emergency Relocation

Where flash flooding submerges a polling unit, voting may be relocated to any nearby dry building outside the registration area.

4. Geo-Coordinates Registry

Electoral Officers shall verify GPS coordinates for all newly split polling units.
v2_text:
1. Threshold for Splitting Populous Polling Units

A polling unit shall be split into voting points or new polling units when the number of registered voters exceeds 750 voters.

2. Notice Period for Relocated Polling Units

Notice of any polling unit relocated from a private residence or worship centre must be published at least 30 days before the election.
---
3. Climate and Flood Emergency Relocation

Where flash flooding submerges a polling unit, voting must be relocated strictly to a designated public school or civic hall within the same registration area.

4. Geo-Coordinates Registry

Electoral Officers shall verify and publish GPS coordinates for all newly split polling units.

document_title: Online Continuous Voter Registration (CVR) Portal Operational Rules
v1_text:
1. Biometric Completion Window for Online Pre-Registrants

Applicants who begin pre-registration on the online CVR portal must complete physical biometric capture within 14 days.

2. Designated Biometric Capture Centres

Physical biometric capture for online pre-registrants is conducted only at the State Headquarters office.
---
3. Treatment of Multiple or Duplicate Registrations

Where an applicant registers more than once during the CVR exercise, both the earlier and later registration records shall be cancelled.

4. Portal Maintenance Window

The online pre-registration portal performs automated backups every Sunday at midnight.
v2_text:
1. Biometric Completion Window for Online Pre-Registrants

Applicants who begin pre-registration on the online CVR portal must complete physical biometric capture within 21 days.

2. Designated Biometric Capture Centres

Physical biometric capture for online pre-registrants is conducted at all 774 Local Government Area offices as well as State Headquarters.
---
3. Treatment of Multiple or Duplicate Registrations

Where an applicant registers more than once during the CVR exercise, the subsequent duplicate registration shall be voided while the original valid registration record is retained.

4. Portal Maintenance Window

The online pre-registration portal performs automated backups every Sunday at 2:00 AM.

document_title: Polling Unit Result Counting, Form EC8A Posting and Transmission Guidelines
v1_text:
1. Public Posting of Form EC8A at Polling Unit

After counting votes, the Presiding Officer may optionally paste a copy of Form EC8A at the polling unit before leaving for the ward collation centre.

2. Electronic Transmission of Result Sheets

The Presiding Officer shall transmit the scanned Form EC8A result sheet only after arriving at the Ward Collation Centre.
---
3. Statutory Definition of Over-Voting

Over-voting occurs where total votes cast at a polling unit exceed the total number of registered voters on the manual register.

4. Packaging of Tamper-Evident Envelopes

Used ballot counterfoils shall be sealed inside envelope EC50A before departure.
v2_text:
1. Public Posting of Form EC8A at Polling Unit

After counting votes, the Presiding Officer must mandatorily paste the duplicate Form EC8A EC60E poster conspicuously at the polling unit before leaving for the ward collation centre.

2. Electronic Transmission of Result Sheets

The Presiding Officer shall scan and transmit the Form EC8A result sheet directly from the polling unit immediately after signing and announcing the scores.
---
3. Statutory Definition of Over-Voting

Over-voting occurs where total votes cast at a polling unit exceed the total number of accredited voters recorded on the BVAS device for that polling unit.

4. Packaging of Tamper-Evident Envelopes

Used ballot counterfoils and result copies shall be sealed inside tamper-evident envelope EC50A before departure.

document_title: Supplementary Directive on Permanent Voter Card (PVC) Collection
v1_text:
1. Prohibition of PVC Collection by Proxy

A registered voter who is unable to attend in person may authorize a family member with a signed power of attorney to collect their PVC.

2. Ward-Level PVC Collection Closing Date

Ward-level devolution of PVC collection shall end on 20 January 2027, after which uncollected cards return to the LGA office.
---
3. Operating Days and Hours for PVC Collection

PVC collection desks operate Monday to Friday between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM and are closed on Saturdays and Sundays.

4. Daily Uncollected PVC Register

Collection officers shall log the serial numbers of collected PVCs at the close of each day.
v2_text:
1. Prohibition of PVC Collection by Proxy

Every registered voter must appear in person to collect their PVC; collection by proxy or power of attorney is strictly prohibited.

2. Ward-Level PVC Collection Closing Date

Ward-level devolution of PVC collection shall end on 5 February 2027, after which uncollected cards return to the LGA office.
---
3. Operating Days and Hours for PVC Collection

PVC collection desks operate Monday to Sunday including Saturdays and Sundays between 8:30 AM and 5:00 PM.

4. Daily Uncollected PVC Register

Collection officers shall log and sign the serial numbers of collected PVCs at the close of each day.

document_title: Guidelines for Election Observation and Media Accreditation
v1_text:
1. Observer Portal Submission Deadline

Domestic election observer groups must upload individual observer photographs and particulars by 5 February 2027.

2. Collation Centre Access Credentials

Accredited observers may enter ward collation centres using either an official INEC observer badge or a letter of introduction from their organization.
---
3. Voting Cubicle Secrecy and Photography

Accredited journalists and voters are permitted to photograph marked ballot papers inside the voting cubicle for personal verification.

4. International Observer Briefing

A joint briefing for accredited observer missions will hold in Abuja three days before the poll.

5. Observer Field Report Submission

Accredited observer groups shall submit their preliminary observation report within 14 days after the election.
v2_text:
1. Observer Portal Submission Deadline

Domestic election observer groups must upload individual observer photographs and particulars by 18 February 2027.

2. Collation Centre Access Credentials

Accredited observers must present a QR-coded official INEC observer badge to enter ward collation centres; letters of introduction alone shall not grant entry.
---
3. Voting Cubicle Secrecy and Photography

Photographing or filming marked ballot papers inside the voting cubicle is strictly prohibited for voters, journalists, and observers.

4. International Observer Briefing

A joint briefing for accredited observer missions will hold in Abuja two days before the poll.

5. Observer Field Report Submission

Accredited observer groups shall submit their preliminary observation report within 30 days after the election.

6. Emergency Incident Escalation Desk

Observers may report critical polling unit incidents through the dedicated observer situation room hotline.
